title: Require Domain Operation Source Topology
forbids: domain operation collections or operation roots outside the positive operation blueprint spine
why: The domain-operation blueprint owns the singular operation-contract registry and executable-leaf topology inside a semantic domain module. Direct domain-root operation source is structurally excluded; the parent module law only admits the operation slot and does not duplicate its internals.
remediate: Place operation source under the owning domain module. Keep the module collection-level contract.ts registry and index.ts implementation registry, keep contract.ts and index.ts in each operation root, and retain only the explicitly admitted operation-local capabilities.
message: Domain operations must match the positive operation blueprint spine.
